name: Fail closed on unmapped guardian-attachment lawful-basis regimes
description: Guardian attachment maps US_COPPA to COPPA and every other DB-mastered regime to GDPR, so a future or accidentally enabled non-GDPR regime could be persisted with a false gdpr_parental_consent lawful basis instead of failing closed.
acceptanceCriteria: Root cause: guardian-attachment.ts uses a binary US_COPPA/else expression even though regimes.code is DB-mastered and intentionally extensible. Behavioral variants: (1) US_COPPA persists coppa_parental_consent; (2) EU_GDPR_13/14/15/16 persist gdpr_parental_consent; (3) UK_AADC persists the explicitly ratified UK/GDPR lawful basis; (4) ROW and any unknown/unmapped regime are rejected before Guardianship or consent writes; (5) adding a new regime cannot silently inherit a lawful basis without an explicit mapping or policy-owned value. Add named unit and transactional real-database regression tests that fail against the permissive else branch and pass with fail-closed mapping, preserve atomic rollback, and keep the mapping aligned with the DB-mastered country-policy contract.
